description: This file defines the WindowGroupLimitExec class and related iterator classes for limiting rows in window functions within Spark SQL execution plan.

classes.name: WindowGroupLimitExec
classes.description: A Spark plan node that filters rows before WindowExec for top-k computations based on partition and order specifications.

classes.name: BaseLimitIterator
classes.description: Abstract iterator class for limiting rows with rank tracking and metrics.

classes.name: SimpleLimitIterator
classes.description: Iterator that limits rows simply by count, increasing rank sequentially.

classes.name: OrderSpecProvider
classes.description: Trait providing ordering and current rank row based on sort specifications.

classes.name: RankLimitIterator
classes.description: Iterator that assigns ranks based on order, handling ties with compare.

classes.name: DenseRankLimitIterator
classes.description: Iterator that assigns dense ranks based on order, incrementing rank on tie breaks.

classes.name: GroupedLimitIterator
classes.description: Iterator that groups rows by partition specification and applies a limit iterator per group.

classes.name: WindowGroupLimitMode
classes.description: Sealed trait representing modes for window group limiting: Partial or Final.

methods.name: withNewChildInternal
methods.description: Creates a new WindowGroupLimitExec with a different child plan.

methods.name: increaseRank
methods.description: Abstract method to increase the rank counter in limit iterators.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator's rank and state.
